007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ConversationPrompt;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017import java.util.List;
018
019/**
020 * Sample for listing prompts recorded for a Select AI conversation.
021 *
022 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, open an
023 * existing {@link Conversation}, call {@link Conversation#listPrompts()}, and
024 * print prompt metadata.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
027 * <ul>
028 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
029 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
030 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
031 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID</li>
032 * </ul>
033 *
034 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
035 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
036 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
037 * <pre>{@code
038 * mvn clean install
039 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
040 * }</pre>
041 *
042 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
043 * <pre>{@code
044 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
045 *   -d samples/out \
046 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/conversation/ListConversationPromptsSample.java
047 * }</pre>
048 *
049 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
050 * <pre>{@code
051 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
052 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation.ListConversationPromptsSample
053 * }</pre>
054 */
055public final class ListConversationPromptsSample {
056    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ListConversationPromptsSample.class);
057
058    private ListConversationPromptsSample() {
059    }
060
061    public static void main(String[] args) {
062        String conversationId = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID");
063
064        try {
065            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
066            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(conversationId);
067            List<ConversationPrompt> prompts = conversation.listPrompts();
068
069            System.out.printf("Conversation ID : %s%n", conversation.getConversationId());
070            System.out.printf("Prompt count    : %d%n", prompts.size());
071            for (ConversationPrompt prompt : prompts) {
072                printPrompt(prompt);
073            }
074        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
075            LOGGER.error("Failed to list prompts for Select AI conversation '{}'.", conversationId, e);
076        }
077    }
078
079    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
080        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
081                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
082                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
083                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
084                .build();
085
086        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
087    }
088
089    private static void printPrompt(ConversationPrompt prompt) {
090        System.out.println();
091        System.out.printf("Prompt ID       : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getConversationPromptId()));
092        System.out.printf("Profile name    : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getProfileName()));
093        System.out.printf("Prompt action   : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getPromptAction()));
094        System.out.printf("Prompt          : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getPrompt()));
095        System.out.printf("Prompt response : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getPromptResponse()));
096        System.out.printf("Created         : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getCreated()));
097        System.out.printf("Modified        : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getModified()));
098        System.out.printf("Client ID       : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getClientIdentifier()));
099        System.out.printf("Client IP       : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getClientIp()));
100        System.out.printf("SID             : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getSid()));
101        System.out.printf("Serial#         : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(prompt.getSerialNumber()));
102    }
103
104    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
105        String value = System.getenv(name);
106        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
107            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
108        }
109        return value;
110    }
111
112    private static String valueOrEmpty(Object value) {
113        return value == null ? "" : String.valueOf(value);
114    }
115}
